title: RICA: Evaluating Robust Inference Capabilities Based on Commonsense Axioms

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model predictions on masked comparative words and demonstrating that models are heavily biased toward predicting words that evoke positive emotions (positive valence, e.g., 'more', 'easier') over negative valence words (e.g., 'less', 'harder'), regardless of the embedded commonsense logic.
